No claim that gold or mercury undergoes a guaranteed bulk transmutation into a named element.
No claim that a person's memories survive as readable photon or isotope correlations.
No claim that a corpse carries an isotope-based exact death timestamp.
No claim that carbon-14 bomb peak identifies a unique person.
No claim that a destroyed body becomes a physical monument or scripture.
No claim about the location, survival, destruction, or measurable state of a soul.
No operational modeling of nuclear weapon use, triggering, interception, vulnerabilities, or effects optimization.
No claim that tragedy was necessary to produce peaceful nuclear applications.
No claim that a reactor is literally a slowed bomb or that fusion is consequence-free.
